artwork.name: bounty-environment-painted
artwork.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: premium 2D illustrated videogame background for a sci-fi Western slot game, wide 16:9, preferably 3072x1728.
Input image 1 is the existing outpost environment reference. Create a new cohesive painted environment retaining this frontier sci-fi Western identity but transforming the bright central sunset into a dim atmospheric charcoal and dark steel outpost at dusk/night.
Sharp confident cel-shaded game concept illustration, rich hand-painted steel architecture, restrained weathered detail, emphatic readable shapes, no photographic CGI or glossy plastic. Strong practical orange lamps and warm edge lighting on the far LEFT architecture, restrained cyan lamps and cool edges on the far RIGHT. Grounded textured landing-pad floor across the lower third, clear plane where characters can stand.
Outer flanks visually rich with frontier industrial architecture, pipes, awnings and distant desert shapes. The middle 50 percent of the entire image must be dark, simple and low-contrast, available behind a large slot overlay. No bright central sun, no central focal object. Central skyline diffuse in dark atmospheric haze.
NO characters, people, robots, guns, text, letters, numbers, reels, slot symbols, UI, borders, logos, watermarks, framing graphics, or captions. This is only the environment.

artwork.name: hunter-six-frame-sheet
artwork.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: production 2D character animation sprite sheet, exactly SIX frames in 3 columns x 2 rows of equal square cells, canvas preferably 3072x2048, each cell 1024x1024. TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA background, no painted background.
Input image 1 establishes the hunter's identity: opaque solid human, tousled dark brown hair, black metal face respirator, weathered orange long armored coat with raised collar and black armor, gloves, utility belt, dark trousers, heavy boots. Preserve that identity.
Input image 2 is only the sci-fi Western atmosphere/style reference. Redesign the hunter as a sharp cel-shaded premium illustrated videogame character matching a painted charcoal/dark-steel outpost, orange practical edge lighting and subtle cool reflected light. Emphatic crisp contour lines, controlled painterly facets, illustrated cloth and steel. NO photographic CGI, translucent hologram, glossy plastic, soft cutout render or transparent body.
The SAME full-body hunter appears once in each of six equally spaced cells, facing three-quarter RIGHT toward screen center. Character centered at the same coordinates in every cell, head top around y=100 and feet bottom at y=920 in every 1024 cell. Feet, stance, torso, coat, camera and scale are IDENTICAL in all six cells; only arms/hands and weapon move. Entire body and weapon must fit each cell with generous margins, no overlap across cells. Consistent character width/height and no anatomy drift.
Read cells left-to-right top-to-bottom as one continuous holster-draw-reload cycle:
Frame 0 top-left: idle, right gloved hand hovering at holstered pistol.
Frame 1 top-middle: same pose, right hand grips holstered pistol.
Frame 2 top-right: same pose, draws pistol just clear of holster.
Frame 3 bottom-left: same pose, pistol held up and angled toward screen RIGHT, non-gory stylized pose, no shot or muzzle flash.
Frame 4 bottom-middle: same body, pistol held across chest with open power cartridge chamber, supporting hand at chamber clearly performing reload.
Frame 5 bottom-right: same body, chamber closed and pistol being lowered toward holster.
TRUE transparent background; fully OPAQUE human and clothing. Do not draw transparency checkerboard. NO floor, drop shadows, cell shadows, numbers, text, captions, cell borders, grid/dividing lines or extra objects. Six separate complete full-body sprites only.

luminanceMattes.name: hunter-six-frame-luminance-matte
luminanceMattes.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: exact luminance compositing mask for the supplied existing sprite sheet. This is a technical matte ONLY, not new artwork.
Edit the referenced image in-place at EXACTLY the same 1536x1024 canvas resolution. Every original foreground character pixel including hair or hat, coat, armor, fingers, gun and boots must become pure opaque WHITE (#FFFFFF). Every background checkerboard pixel must become pure BLACK (#000000). Output one RGB black-and-white PNG matte: six solid white silhouettes on pure black.
CRITICAL INVARIANTS: Preserve the exact original position, scale, contour, stance and pixel alignment of all SIX figures. Do not shift, center, redraw, resize or rearrange any figure. Do not regularize the row spacing. Keep original source framing including tight margins and any pose differences. The mask must exactly overlay the supplied RGB image as a matching luminance mask.
Remove all internal illustration detail: the complete interior of each figure must be uniformly WHITE, irrespective of original color. Preserve true background holes between arms/body/legs and around guns as BLACK. Only a fine anti-aliased boundary between foreground and background is acceptable; no glow, shadows, outlines, blur, checkerboard, textures, labels, grid lines or text. Do not return the original colored art; return the precise white foreground silhouette mask on black.
